messages:
alex: deploy-bot just kicked off a config-only rollout for routing TTL and warmup batching
deploy-bot: Config-only rollout `cfg-2026-03-18-routing-ttl-warmup` started
deploy-bot: Changes: `routing.ttl=3s -> 1s`, `batching.warmup_ms=200 -> 50`, `batching.max_window_ms=500 -> 300`, `request.timeout_ms=12000 -> 15000`
mira: heads-up: change window is 30m starting now, will monitor infra dashboard :eyes:
sam: can we pin the canary to model-variant `v2-quant` in us-west for this run? want to avoid any cross-variant noise
alex: yes, pinning to `v2-quant` for 5% canary. fallback policy: automatic revert to previous routing if error-rate spike > 1.5% or p95 request latency > 800ms
jordan: added a temporary alert: `cfg-rollout:error-rate>1.2% 2m` and `cfg-rollout:p95>700ms 2m`
paula: rollback plan: manual rollback if customer-facing errors > 1% for more than 3 contiguous minutes, otherwise auto-revert will trigger. noting support on-call is standby :phone:
mira: small note — lowering TTL might increase cache misses; expecting a transient qps bump, watch redis miss rate and prefix-cache hit %
sam: also watch token-cost per request; batching warmup decrease could raise small-request count, I put a short grafana panel on watchlist
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% in us-west: 10/200 pods. No immediate errors after 2 minutes :white_check_mark:
alex: if canary stays green for 10 mins we'll push to 25% and then 100% over the next 20 mins, unless alerts fire
jordan: observed a small uptick in KV-store latency ~30s after rollout started, still within SLO but keeping eye. adding note to thread
paula: adding release-notes entry: "Config tweak: reduced routing TTL and shortened batching warmup to improve tail latency; increased request timeout to accommodate wider tail." will push to changelog after full rollout
mira: ack, logging retention increased for this change window (extra 2x) for faster root-cause if needed
sam: if anything odd, i'll pin traffic back to previous routing config with `rctl rollback cfg-2026-03-17-routing` and start the rollback playbook
deploy-bot: Rolling to 25% now per schedule
alex: thanks — team on watch. if we see >1% 5xx or p95 spikes, rollback immediately. otherwise proceed with staged ramp. :thumbsup:"
